analyst_view.overall: Early view: Iván Ania's Córdoba drew 3-3 at Mallorca after leading 3-1 late, with two goals from Ghailan, and collected five yellow cards. Oviedo lost 1-2 at home to Girona in Raúl González's first game in charge, without the injured Dani Calvo, so this will be his second game.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, already high, and I agree. Córdoba's games keep producing goals (3-3 at Mallorca) and Oviedo's away games have been lively, so a low-scoring game would be the surprise.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.5 corners, with 7.4 for Córdoba, which suits a team that attacks through crosses. I would not go higher because Oviedo, strong away, will not simply sit back.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.3 cards. I have moved from same to higher: Córdoba picked up five yellows at Mallorca after ending a recent away game with nine men, and Raúl has asked his Oviedo players for total commitment after a losing debut.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.9 shots, very high for this division. I lean lower: Oviedo's best away results have been compact ones, and a new coach coming off a defeat is likely to put structure first.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. I lean slightly lower with the shots: Córdoba's crossing game produces many attempts that miss the target, and Oviedo's attack is without Chris Ramos.
